#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

string cs;
int n;
long long res;
int X;

void dfs(int u, long long s) {
    if (u >= n) {
        if (s % 25 == 0) res++;
        return;
    }
    char c = cs[u];
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
        dfs(u + 1, s * 10 + (c - '0'));
    } else if (c == 'X') {
        dfs(u + 1, s * 10 + X);
    } else { // '_'
        if (u == n - 1) {
            dfs(u + 1, s * 10 + 5);
            dfs(u + 1, s * 10);
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                if (i == 0 && u == 0) continue;
                dfs(u + 1, s * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }
}

void solve() {
    cin >> cs;
    n = cs.length();
    res = 0;
    bool flag = false;
    for (char c : cs) {
        if (c == 'X') {
            flag = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (cs[0] == '0' && n != 1) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return;
    }
    if (flag) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            if (cs[0] == 'X' && n > 1 && i == 0) continue;
            X = i;
            dfs(0, 0);
        }
    } else {
        dfs(0, 0);
    }
    cout << res << endl;
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
